Emergencies

توغل في المدرج

Any occurrence at an aerodrome involving the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle, or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and take-off of aircraft.

Quick answer: Any occurrence at an aerodrome involving the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle, or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and take-off of aircraft.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is توغل في المدرج?

In this glossary, توغل في المدرج refers to: Any occurrence at an aerodrome involving the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle, or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and take-off of aircraft.

How is توغل في المدرج used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "البرج، لاحظنا توغل مركبة في المدرج قرب نقطة الانتظار ألفا تو، نطلب التحقق."

توغل في المدرج matters because it supports clear communication in Emergencies contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.
